name: threads-content-studio
description: Threads Content Studio - Tự động hóa sản xuất video từ nội dung Threads (Production Readiness & Performance Optimization Edition)

scripts.dev:desktop: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT,DESKTOP" -c "blue,green,magenta" "pnpm --filter threads-studio-server dev" "pnpm --filter threads-studio-client dev" "pnpm --filter threads-studio-desktop dev"
